verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a separate test environment for in-person payments: a test Customer Area, an orderable test card for simulating card brands, CVMs and declines, and a testing system for validating the integration before switching to live transactions. Because test and live are distinct, production data stays untouched. missing for 10: Adyen itself calls the testing system 'basic' and the docs give little depth on simulated scenario coverage, terminal testing relies on ordering a physical test card, nothing explicitly confirms test/production data isolation, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
